measurementPolicy.criteria: Customer acceptance outcomes; counted separately from capability-specific release gates.
measurementPolicy.gates: Eleven per capability are release assessments, not additional customer features. Shared execution evidence may support multiple assessments only when scope matches.
measurementPolicy.productionRule: Current production verification requires independently supplied mechanical release identity. Historical evidence remains preserved but becomes stale when its release differs, unless the release verifier proves an explicit unchanged asset scope.
measurementPolicy.evidenceOnlyReleaseRule: G09 current identity is derived from external mechanical release context. Functional evidence may carry forward only through an explicit releaseScope whose paths are mechanically unchanged; acceptance.json cannot carry itself forward.
